subject.title: feat(github-copilot): add native web search for Copilot GPT models

question: After Copilot native-search capability is proven, should it activate automatically and should this payload wrapper become public Plugin SDK API?
rationale: The proposal replaces an existing fallback by default and creates a new third-party compatibility contract, so maintainers must choose the durable product and ownership boundary.

options.title: Capability-driven approved seam
options.body: Keep eligibility plugin-owned, preserve managed fallback for unknown models, and expose only an explicitly approved generic SDK helper.

options.title: Bundled-only helper
options.body: Share the implementation internally without committing the behavior as public third-party API.

options.title: Defer automatic search
options.body: Keep managed search until GitHub provides stable native-search capability metadata.

recommendation.title: Capability-driven approved seam
recommendation.body: Keep eligibility plugin-owned, preserve managed fallback for unknown models, and expose only an explicitly approved generic SDK helper.

likelyOwner.reason: Their current-main implementation is the behavior being generalized, providing the strongest available ownership signal for the permanent default and API boundary.
